# qrcodegen (vendored)

Project Nayuki's QR Code generator, its C version: `c/qrcodegen.c` and `c/qrcodegen.h` from
github.com/nayuki/QR-Code-generator at bcfe1b01 (2026-10-29), unchanged. MIT (LICENSE).

Used by OpenSWOS Setup (tools/swosdata/app) for the QR code a phone scans to copy the game's
data over Wi-Fi (docs/MOBILE.md, "Copying over Wi-Fi"). To update: fetch the two files again,
note the commit here.
